thread:
maria (Finance): quick pulse — BrightEdge Feb invoice looks off. Billing shows 1,220,432 embedding units billed but our ingestion pipeline metrics and customer quota show ~611k. filing as discrepancy. attaching meter dump and query results.

alex (Billing Ops): can you paste the metering query / results inline? is this across all models or a specific embedding route? any spike in rate-limit errors or retries?

maria (Finance): pasted the summary below. seems isolated to their embedding route (/v1/embeddings). query: ```SELECT customer_id, SUM(embedding_count) AS billed FROM metering.events WHERE date >= '2026-02-01' AND date <= '2026-02-28' AND route = '/v1/embeddings' AND customer_id = 'cust_brightedge' GROUP BY customer_id; -- result: billed=1220432``` Our pipeline (consumer-side) shows: ```processed_embeddings_total: 611128```

jia (SRE): I saw related logs in the ingestion cluster around 2026-02-14 03:12 UTC. Client retries were hitting a 5xx then succeeding, but there was no idempotency key, so duplicate rows were written to the metering topic. quick log snippet: ```[2026-02-14T03:12:01Z] ingest-service INFO request_id=abc123 status=500 upstream_error=timeout
[2026-02-14T03:12:02Z] ingest-client INFO retrying request_id=abc123 (no idempotency-key)
[2026-02-14T03:12:03Z] ingest-service INFO request_id=abc123 status=200 accepted=true``` That pattern will produce duplicate metering entries because we track per-request instead of deduping on request_id.

sam (Acct Mgmt): I pinged BrightEdge. They confirm they had a transient network issue and client retried around that time. They said they didn't include an idempotency header in their SDK calls. they're OK with a billing correction as long as we document the change and apply a credit for the duplicated portion.

maria (Finance): Proposed remediation: run a backfill/dedupe job that identifies duplicate request_ids for cust_brightedge and subtracts duplicated embedding counts from Feb invoice (effectively create a negative line item). estimated duplicate amount ~= billed - pipeline = 609,304 units. Need finance approval to issue credit and ops approval to run backfill (it will touch metering ledger).

alex (Billing Ops): technical plan: 1) snapshot current ledger, 2) run dedupe query to compute duplicates: ```WITH dup AS (SELECT request_id, COUNT(*) c, SUM(embedding_count) s FROM metering.events WHERE customer_id='cust_brightedge' AND date BETWEEN '2026-02-01' AND '2026-02-28' GROUP BY request_id HAVING COUNT(*)>1) SELECT SUM(s) AS duplicate_units FROM dup;``` 3) create negative invoice lines and post credit memo. I'll also add an invariant check to prevent double-counting in future (reject duplicates at write time if request_id seen). ops will run in a read-only dry-run first.

jia (SRE): sounds good. I can run the dry-run and produce a change log. Note: there are about ~420k request_ids duplicated once and ~30k duplicated more than twice — expect the ledger adjustments to be a bit noisy; we'll include per-request audit rows so Finance can reconcile. We'll also throttle the backfill to avoid load on DB.

courtney (Finance Lead): approve provisional credit up to 650k embedding units (~safe cap). Condition: we need the dry-run audit and the full list of request_ids before posting credit. Also require a ticket in billing-adjustments and a line in the monthly adjustments spreadsheet with rationale. Please include an "adjustment_reason": "duplicate_ingest_client_retries" field in the credit memo metadata.

alex (Billing Ops): ack. I'll start the dry-run today, upload the CSV of duplicate_request_ids to the billing ticket, and draft the credit memo with that adjustment_reason. target for final posting: 2026-03-05 EOD.

billing-bot: Scheduled task created: backfill-dedupe-cust_brightedge (dry-run) queued by alex. ETA: 30m. job_id=bf-20260305-ax1.

maria (Finance): thanks — Sam, please coordinate comms with the customer once the credit is posted. Include the CSV of deduped request_ids if they ask. Sam: can you confirm outreach plan?

sam (Acct Mgmt): will send an email template with breakdown + note that we've added a write-side duplicate guard and will monitor. cc'ing legal if they ask for more. planned send after credit posts.

courtney (Finance Lead): one more ask: log this as "non-recurring billing adjustment" in our P&L notes for Feb so accounting knows why revenue was reduced.

alex (Billing Ops): will do. I'll update the billing ticket with the P&L tag and link to the adjustment memo. starting dry-run now, will update thread with dry-run result and final duplicate_units number. :white_check_mark:
